device.model: CECC-X PLC with the FPosBAPI CoDeSys server
device.name: Festo FPosBAPI gantry (FPosBAPIClient)

facts.text: The FPosBAPI server on the CECC-X PLC listens on TCP port 1234 and speaks a line-oriented ASCII protocol; a successful response ends with 0, NULL, SUCCESS
MOVE_LOC is a coordinated 3-axis move to explicit X, Y and Z target coordinates in mm (a1, a2, a3)
HOME homes all axes through one PLC command
ROB_POS reports the current position as x_mm, y_mm and z_mm
Velocity is written to PLC parameter 103 (global speed) in mm/s
SYS_STATUS returns the system status string of the PLC
IS_ERROR reports whether the gantry is in an error state
FPB_ERROR and READ_ERR report the fieldbus error state and the current error description
RESET_ERR resets the active controller error
Always home the gantry before commanding absolute moves
The library can command real mechanical motion: commission and test the hardware first, keep the machine clear, and verify that every target position and velocity is safe
